content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

When considering alternatives to Stripe and PayPal for selling digital products like fonts, it's essential to understand what each option brings to the table. Traditional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer ease of use but come with restrictions and fees. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure providers like COREMERCH offer a more comprehensive solution, including automatic crypto payment processing and full data ownership, empowering creators to take control of their digital storefronts.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude many countries, leaving creators without access to mainstream payment processing. This exclusion isn't just about geographical restrictions; it's also about the lack of sovereignty over one's digital commerce. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, operates independently of these restrictions, providing a pathway for creators in any country to sell their digital products without relying on platforms that may not support their location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The speed at which payments are processed and the fees associated with these transactions are critical considerations for digital creators. Traditional platforms often charge higher fees and may hold funds for extended periods. In contrast, using a sovereign commerce infrastructure with a payment gateway like NOWPayments, which charges a 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, can significantly reduce costs and increase payment speed, ensuring creators receive their earnings promptly.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your digital storefront.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of one's digital storefront and the ability to automate and deliver products instantly are key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Supabase for order storage, creators can ensure they have full control over their digital products and customer data. This approach also enables instant product delivery, reducing the complexity and costs associated with traditional e-commerce platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for selling digital products depends on the creator's specific situation, including their location, the type of products they sell, and their technical expertise. For those in restricted countries or seeking full control over their digital commerce, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a robust and scalable solution. By understanding the trade-offs between traditional platforms and sovereign infrastructure, creators can make informed decisions that align with their business goals and values.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If you're asking how to sell digital products without Stripe or PayPal, the answer lies in sovereign commerce infrastructure, which provides a comprehensive, low-cost, and highly automated solution. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can bypass traditional payment platforms' restrictions and fees, ensuring they can sell their products to a global audience without compromise.
Traditional payment platforms can exclude your country or hold your funds indefinitely.

Then, set up order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, configure automatic crypto payment processing with NOWPayments. Finally, test your setup end-to-end to ensure seamless product delivery and payment processing. Each step is crucial in building a robust and independent digital storefront.
